biotools.summary: RFantibody is a pipeline for structure-based de novo antibody and nanobody design, integrating backbone design with RFdiffusion, sequence design with ProteinMPNN, and structure prediction with RoseTTAFold2. It provides a comprehensive toolset for generating and filtering high-quality antibody designs.
